title: I turned Higgsfield into a video-making app
description:
Higgsfield launched Apps, and you can connect it straight to Claude as a custom connector in about ten seconds. From there you describe the tool you want and it builds a mini app running on the best image and video models available. The example here takes ten property listing photos and returns a finished walkthrough video, consistently, every time.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IozOiO5N44g3YCk0yjkNbfuuYPgxb7Li_Ti4CI31r00/edit?usp=sharing
